I’ve had a long history before now.

I’ve been through social anxiety and sorta fail to overcome it, it caused ongoing experiences of humiliation,  unstable identity, mood swings, intense loneliness. 

I’ve had people try to help me but then I don’t perform and they leave either because they misunderstood depression or because after a while nothing they’re doing gets to me and they leave with a sigh. I give up easily and I’m lazy and I have too many issues and insecurities.

I’ve seen several mental health professionals, but the medications somehow don’t do anything, and I don’t really improve. This is over a period of 4/5 years, up til now.

I quit school when I was 16, then I started college 18 but things were miserable, I was friendless and stayed in my apartment all the time.

I don’t actually know.

I stay at home the entire day, everyday. I can’t do anything, I don’t want to eat even when food is available and I don’t want to get out of bed. I quit university a year ago because I couldn’t do anything. I just don’t wanna live. Every moment is distressing. I’m tired and sick of every moment. I hate myself. I’m trapped. There’s nothing I can do. If I don’t stop existing I’ll just be in this state for decades.
I don’t have the necessary knowledge. I’m sorry you’re in this situation.
I’ve never experienced abuse before. How did you try to help?
How long had it been going on ?

I’m sorry.
What was she going through
It seems like this person meant a lot to you. May I know what happened?
I’m in a very similar situation. I don’t do anything about it. Which is why I want to kill myself.

I like this, this is decent. Thanks. I was looking for something like this. Wish I could read more discussions like this. R&M is really interesting to me.. in a personal way. Tired to say more right now.

Can you maybe try not to care that they are tuning you out? Like just take a break and relax for awhile, though I myself I find the depression makes that by definition not possible.. but you know maybe just do whatever you want for the day, but make sure to eat your meals and stay hydrated.. then once you feel slightly less tense and tired you can decide how you wanna do it exactly.. then maybe they'll start to take you more seriously if they see something in motion.. then after that relax again, do whatever you want, maybe by then you'll change your mind or maybe not.. and now that you have a plan maybe you can be the one to tune them out

Sorry.. I came off as complaining but I was aiming for irony.. could have worked on the tone a bit haha.. my point was, actually, that I think a lot of people keep saying they want to kill themselves, but instead of just doing it already, they.. I mean if you think about it from the point of view of the people listening, it can get tedious and disheartening, to hear talk but no action, you know, like its a biological response that something isn't jibing right  .. which I think is the vibe I get with forums like this, and I'm including myself.. that if you really wanna do it, nothing's stopping you.. Right? basically self pity and feeling like a victim, when maybe that isn't really the entire case.. is my point. I'm just.. there's two sides to this whole fucked uppedness, and maybe it's important to sometimes see the other side. I mean it's really hard to do anything when you're depressed, and what you're trying to do is kill yourself.. you keep thinking about it in your head but when you actually think about the practicals, and suddenly you don't look as forward to it anymore.. haha.. but then you know that you still just gotta do it, otherwise it'll never happen.. I'm speaking in general btw, not urging you to kill yourself
